physicalEvidence.summary: Full Sim-on-Wheels paper (June 2023; RA-L 2023, presented ICRA 2024) evaluates a behavior-cloned FCN/GRU brake model on a physical Polaris GEM e2 with drive-by-wire, ZED2 and onboard A4000. The moving vehicle responds to virtual hazards composited into live images; PI/Stanley low-level control remains conventional. Thus vehicle execution is real, hazards and collision metrics are augmented. Tests used a closed track, safety driver and lookout. This is a shared UIUC project from 2023, not proof of current individual lab access. Physical20.
